description: Maintain BOTH documentation layers as one linked wiki after a change: technical docs in docs/ and functional docs in docs-functional/. Use after implementing or changing a feature, when the user says "update the docs", "sync the documentation", "the docs are out of date", "document how this works", or as the documentation step of a development cycle. Also use when a good answer to a real question deserves to become a page. Reads the layer index first, routes each change to the right layer, cross-links related pages, and flags stale sections. Do NOT use for ADRs (governance-author-adr), the constitution (governance-constitution), or API spec / OpenAPI generation.
